coverage_exempt.reason: operator new returns 0, then the original dereferences the null pointer at 0x48a9de; no normal-return input exists. The native body must keep the read and fault.

Taken only when the flag-set bit count at +0x2fc is 8 or less. Base constructor 0x44c000 always leaves 0x20 or more, and the only way to lower it is a failing allocation, which the original faults on (0x4dc680 reads [ebp+4] with ebp zero).

limits: Win32 rectangle imports and InterlockedDecrement are scripted fixtures; the heap/lock runtime is fixtured.
Constructor base-class chain, vtable calls and logic-state registry run as original code or case-supplied pointers.
